description: Fast batch insertion of multiple CAD entities (LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, XLINE, RAY, DONUT, SOLID, TRACE, WIPEOUT, SPLINE, ARRAY (associative rect/polar/path), MLINE (multiline), TABLE (title, header and data cells), IMAGE (picture embedded in the drawing), TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, LEADER, HATCH (pattern or gradient), POINT, INSERT, POLYLINE3D). LINE, POINT and POLYLINE3D points take z.

entities.description: Array of CAD entity definition objects

arrowSize.description: DIMENSION: arrowhead size in drawing units

characteristic.description: TOLERANCE: position, concentricity, symmetry, parallelism, perpendicularity, angularity, cylindricity, flatness, circularity, straightness, surfaceprofile, lineprofile, runout, totalrunout

columnWidths.description: TABLE: width of each column (or columns + columnWidth, default 63.5)

controlPoints.description: SPLINE control vertices (with degree, optional weights, closed)

data.description: TABLE: data rows (arrays of cell text; MTEXT codes such as \P allowed)

dimType.description: linear, aligned, radius, diameter, jogged, angular, ordinate, arclength. Optional: textPoint, textAngle and obliqueAngle (radians), jogLine; jogged: centerOverride, jogPoint

dir.description: XLINE / RAY direction (or give through: {x,y} or angle in radians)

file.description: IMAGE: path of a PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP or WebP file inside the server folder (embedded in the drawing); or dataUrl / base64 with name; with position, width (default: pixel width) and rotation

fitPoints.description: SPLINE through these points (with optional startTangent, endTangent, knotMethod chord|sqrt|uniform, closed)

gradient.description: HATCH gradient fill: { name: LINEAR|CYLINDER|INVCYLINDER|SPHERICAL|INVSPHERICAL|HEMISPHERICAL|INVHEMISPHERICAL|CURVED|INVCURVED, color1, color2, angle (radians), centered }. Saved to DXF as a solid fill of color1 (AutoCAD 2000 has no gradients).

justification.description: TEXT: Left, Center, Right, TL, TC, TR, ML, MC, MR, BL, BC, BR. MLINE: top, zero or bottom

kind.description: ARRAY: rect (rows, cols, rowSpacing, colSpacing), polar (center, count, fill, rotateItems) or path (path, method divide|measure, count|spacing, rows, rowSpacing, align)

mlineStyle.description: MLINE: multiline style name (default Standard); with points, closed and scale (default 20)

sources.description: ARRAY: entity definitions that are arrayed

tableStyle.description: TABLE: table style name (default Standard); with position, rowLines and rotation

textSize.description: DIMENSION: text height in drawing units (e.g. 120 for a plan in mm); with arrowSize and precision (decimals)

tolerance.description: TOLERANCE value, e.g. "0.1", "d0.05M" (d = diameter, M/L/S = material condition)

type.description: LINE, LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, ELLIPSE, XLINE, RAY, DONUT, SOLID, TRACE, WIPEOUT, SPLINE, ARRAY, MLINE, TABLE, IMAGE, TEXT, MTEXT, DIMENSION, TOLERANCE, LEADER, HATCH, POINT, INSERT, POLYLINE3D

name: cad_batch_add_entities
